component.name: abraflexi-cashier
component.summary: Cash withdrawal and receipt generation tool for AbraFlexi

description.p: Cashier for AbraFlexi is a PHP-based command-line tool that automates cash register management by generating weekly expense receipts based on the current balance in your AbraFlexi account.

ul.li: Iterating through weeks from earliest to most recent transactions
Automatically creating expense receipts at week-end
